author: agent
objective: Among 36 OECD countries, association of 2017 population-weighted annual PM2.5 concentration with log COVID-19 case and death rates at 60 and 80 days after each country's first confirmed case, adjusted for age 65+, density, GDP, physicians, and hospital beds.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Among 36 OECD countries, association of 2017 population-weighted annual PM2.5 concentration with log COVID-19 case and death rates at 60 and 80 days after each country's first confirmed case, adjusted for age 65+, density, GDP, physicians, and hospital beds.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: National COVID-19 confirmed case and death rates among the populations of 36 OECD countries, at 60 and 80 epidemic days after first confirmed case.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Per 1 µg/m³ increase in 2017 population-weighted annual PM2.5; effect is exp(beta) for log outcome rate.
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: 36 OECD countries as of March 2020, excluding Colombia

article_evidence.finding: Methods establish country-level 2017 PM2.5 and logged day-60/day-80 outcome-rate regressions.
Table 1 establishes the four outcome variants and adjustment variables.

execution_design.assignment_method: Direct assignment of public World Bank country-level population-weighted PM2.5 indicator to its ISO3 national administrative unit; no monitor interpolation is applicable.
execution_design.exposure_metric: 2017 annual population-weighted mean PM2.5 concentration in µg/m³ (World Bank EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3).
execution_design.daily_aggregation: Not applicable: the locked long-term exposure is an annual country indicator, not a monitor daily series.
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: One 2017 country exposure per ISO3 merged to two country-level outcome dates.

coverage_policy.threshold_source: Article specifies no numeric coverage threshold
coverage_policy.evidence: All 36 countries have PM2.5; USA has no allowed-window physician value, leaving 35 complete countries per model.

execution_design.intended_use: Exposure predictor in four article-aligned OLS models of log COVID-19 rate.

coverage_policy.evidence: All 36 countries have PM2.5; USA has no allowed-window physician value, leaving 35 complete countries per model.

changed_dimensions.intended_use: Exposure predictor in four article-aligned OLS models of log COVID-19 rate.

evidence.finding: All 36 ISO3 units contain a 2017 PM2.5 value; exposure is directly country-level and population-weighted.
The only complete-case loss is the USA physician covariate, not exposure coverage.

amendments.scientific_justification: The article itself defines population-weighted national PM2.5, so a public country indicator is the matching spatial and temporal support; monitor assignment would change the exposure construct.
